verdict.rationale: The pack shows that Proton Pass generates TOTP codes (docs-5) and can export and import data (docs-3, docs-4, docs-11). None of it documents restoring tokens on a new device after losing a phone: there is no account-sync restore and no statement that exports include TOTP secrets or can be re-imported into Proton Pass. Export and import are adjacent backup and migration features, not a documented recovery path for this story.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device
